abstain_message: I cannot answer this question reliably with the available evidence, so I have not guessed. See the warnings for what was missing.

satvlm_semantics.note: Plan section 11.0: never display a generic 'AI confidence' percentage for generated free text.

single_scene_vqa.notes: Free-text scene description is scored on evidence coverage and claim validation, so accept requires answer_status=verified and unsupported_claims=0.

bi_temporal_change.notes: Threshold applies to the ChangeNet mask score. SatVLM composition is reported separately and gates the answer on claim validation, never on its own percentage.

optical_sar_land_cover.notes: Per-class confidence is calibrated on a geographic validation split. Optical-only, SAR-only and fused scores are reported side by side and never averaged (plan section 10.3).
